shameful behavior: Cheating in the game and then lying about it was shameful behavior, and the player later apologized to his fans.
在比賽中作弊後又說謊是可恥的行為，那名選手後來向球迷道歉。
a shameful secret: For years he kept a shameful secret: he had stolen money from his own grandmother.
多年來他一直藏著一個羞於見人的秘密：他曾偷過自己祖母的錢。
a shameful waste: Throwing away so much good food every day is a shameful waste when many people go hungry.
在許多人挨餓的時候，每天丟掉這麼多好好的食物是可恥的浪費。
sheer luck: I didn't study at all for the test, so passing it was sheer luck.
我完全沒準備那次考試，所以能及格純屬運氣。
sheer hard work: She didn't have rich parents; she got into National Taiwan University through sheer hard work.
她沒有有錢的父母；她完全靠努力考上了台灣大學。
sheer volume: The sheer volume of homework this week made me stay up until midnight every night.
這週龐大的作業量讓我每晚都熬到半夜。
a sheer drop: Be careful near the edge of the cliff; there is a sheer drop of over a hundred meters.
在懸崖邊要小心；那裡有一個超過一百公尺的垂直陡坡。
sheer nonsense: The story that drinking cola can cure a cold is sheer nonsense, so please don't believe it.
喝可樂能治感冒的說法是一派胡言，所以請不要相信。
by sheer chance: By sheer chance, I met my old classmate on a train in Tokyo after ten years apart.
純屬巧合，我在分開十年後於東京的火車上遇到了老同學。
sheer determination: Through sheer determination, the injured runner finished the race even though he could barely walk.
憑著純然的決心，那名受傷的跑者即使幾乎走不動，還是跑完了比賽。
the sheer size of: Visitors are often amazed by the sheer size of Taipei 101 when they stand at its base.
遊客站在台北101底下時，常對它龐大的規模感到驚嘆。
a shiny new car: My uncle drove to the family dinner in a shiny new car that he had just bought.
我叔叔開著他剛買的閃亮的新車來參加家庭聚餐。
shiny hair: This shampoo promises soft, shiny hair after just one week of use.
這款洗髮精保證只要用一週，就能擁有柔順又有光澤的頭髮。
a shiny surface: Polish the wooden table until it has a shiny surface that reflects light like a mirror.
把木桌擦亮，直到它有像鏡子一樣能反光的光滑的表面。
a signature dish: Beef noodle soup is the restaurant's signature dish, and almost every customer orders it.
牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌菜，幾乎每位客人都會點。
one's signature style: Bright red lipstick and big sunglasses became the singer's signature style, which fans copied everywhere.
鮮紅口紅和大墨鏡成了那位歌手的標誌性風格，粉絲們到處模仿。
a signature move: The basketball star's signature move is a spinning jump shot that kids try to copy on the playground.
那位籃球明星的招牌動作是轉身跳投，孩子們在球場上都想模仿。
a signature tune: Every time the TV show starts, its signature tune plays, and my kids start singing along.
每次那個電視節目開始，它的主題曲一響起，我的孩子們就跟著唱。
a significant increase: There has been a significant increase in the number of students taking online English courses this year.
今年參加線上英文課程的學生人數有顯著的增加。
a significant role: Parents play a significant role in helping their children develop good reading habits.
父母在幫助孩子養成良好閱讀習慣上扮演重要的角色。
a significant other: Guests are welcome to bring their significant other to the wedding party next Saturday.
歡迎賓客帶另一半來參加下週六的婚宴。
statistically significant: The study found a statistically significant difference between students who slept well and those who didn't.
這項研究發現睡得好的學生和睡不好的學生之間有統計上顯著的差異。
a significant look: When the guest mentioned the surprise party, Mom gave Dad a significant look, telling him to keep quiet.
當客人提到驚喜派對時，媽媽給了爸爸一個意味深長的眼神，要他保持安靜。
be significant that…: It is significant that none of the students complained, which shows how much they liked the new teacher.
沒有一個學生抱怨這點很重要，這顯示他們有多喜歡新老師。
sincere thanks: I'd like to express my sincere thanks to all the volunteers who helped clean the beach last weekend.
我想向上週末幫忙清理海灘的所有志工表達誠摯的感謝。
a sincere apology: After breaking the window, the boy made a sincere apology to his neighbor and offered to pay for it.
打破窗戶後，那個男孩向鄰居真誠的道歉，並表示願意賠償。
sincere condolences: Please accept our sincere condolences on the loss of your father; he was a kind man.
對於令尊的過世，請接受我們誠摯的哀悼；他是個善良的人。
a sincere effort: Although he failed the test, he made a sincere effort to study, so his teacher encouraged him.
雖然他考試沒過，但他付出了真誠的努力去讀書，所以老師鼓勵了他。
